_meta._note: S203 Solar Open 2 tech report Figure 1 — CAPABILITY-GROUP AGGREGATE benchmarks that are NOT in Tables 3/4 (which list only individual benches). Figure 1 groups results into aggregates: K-Knowledge (Korean language & culture = CLIcK + HAE-RAE avg), K-Domain (Korean professional = KBank-MMLU + KBL + KorMedMCQA avg), MATH (HMMT2602 + AIME2026 avg). K-OfficeAgent group == Ko-GDPval (already ingested as ko_gdpval). GDPval-AA-v2 Figure-1 value is a normalized score (SO2 31.4) vs the Table-3 ELO 1128 (already ingested as gdpval_aa_elo) — same benchmark, different scale, ELO kept as canonical. Only Upstage's own models (Solar Open 2 / Solar Open 1) ingested; baselines (Claude Haiku 4.5, MiMo-V2.5, GPT-5.4 mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Command A+, Mistral Medium 3.5) are Upstage-measured comparisons -> not ingested.
